subject: prop
title: The folding ladder
description: The one ladder Yoru carries, as the resident draws it while it hangs over a ledge, and the shape every ladder clip is drawn from. Wolf chose a folding wooden ladder on 2026-10-24.
propDescription: A small, slightly too nice folding wooden ladder from Yoru's world, painted in the same painterly anime-fantasy style as Yoru himself with dark outlines: warm dark wood worn smooth, two straight parallel side rails, evenly spaced round rungs, a pair of small brass hinges halfway up where it folds in half, and two small brass hooks at the very top for hanging it over an edge. A straight ladder, never an A-frame step ladder.

clips.action: The ladder fully unfolded and straight, standing upright and seen exactly from the front, hooks at the top, nine rungs.
beats: The open ladder, upright, seen from the front, its feet on the floor line.

clips.action: The same ladder folded in half at its brass hinges into a compact bundle, standing upright, seen from the front, a thin leather strap around it.
beats: The folded ladder bundle, upright, standing on the floor line.
